plan.name: Attribute Go proofs to components
plan.summary: Add the proof-attribution and receipt foundation for explicit Go components: accept successful tool results tied to exact component IDs and source snapshots, require coverage of the selected contracts, and list every neighboring component as unchecked unless it has its own qualifying result. Keep proof evidence separate from future evidence kinds, bind the complete inventory and proof provenance into deterministic fingerprints, and render JSON and Markdown without turning a partial proof into a project-wide or every-size claim; escape every source-derived value written to Markdown, including component and contract IDs, paths and proof diagnostics, so pipes, backticks and line breaks cannot end a code span, table cell or row or forge proof status. Preserve legacy Go, Python and TypeScript receipts, gate outcomes, ratified statements and the refusal to execute explicit component checks. Update SPEC.md and README.md to describe this API-only slice and its limits, citing D-0013, D-0024, D-0135, D-0152, D-0158 and D-0122 as applicable. The merger must record the new attribution policy, which has no decision yet, and open the remaining work through #224: bounded or sampled conformance, runtime checks and trusted assumptions as separate evidence kinds, component dashboard views, Python and TypeScript discovery, and explicit check execution followed by removal of verify.ErrComponents.

tests.name: TestComponentProofAttributionKeepsNeighborsUnchecked
tests.says: A successful proof belongs only to its exact selected target; every scoped function, method and initializer remains visible, and neighboring or identically named components stay unchecked.

tests.name: TestComponentProofRequiresSuccessfulExactCoverage
tests.says: Missing, failed, empty or incomplete proof output establishes no proof, even when the build, legacy proof or model checks succeeded.

tests.name: TestComponentProofRejectsUnboundOrStaleResults
tests.says: Unknown, duplicate, unselected or stale component evidence is rejected without changing the report.

tests.name: TestComponentProofFingerprintsBindSourcesAndContracts
tests.says: Fingerprints cover scope, source files, component identities, selected contracts and proof outcomes, survive reordering and checkout relocation, and ignore existing volatile run metadata.

tests.name: TestComponentProofReceiptsShowCoverageAndPreserveLegacy
tests.says: JSON and Markdown show proof coverage and unchecked neighbors without a blanket proof claim, while successful legacy Go, Python and TypeScript receipts remain byte-for-byte compatible.

tests.name: TestComponentProofAttributionKeepsExecutionDisabled
tests.says: Attribution executes no tools, does not change gate pass or fail, and leaves explicit component verification refused before any tools run.

tests.name: TestComponentProofMarkdownCannotForgeProofStatus
tests.says: Source filenames, including core/x|proved|tail.go and names with backticks or line breaks, remain inert in component identities, contract references and diagnostics: the Markdown table keeps every unchecked component unchecked, with intact cells and rows, and JSON retains the original identities.
